title: Tcf7l2 aligns with Ctnnb1 and opposes Apc at the beta-catenin/TCF node in 151 TH neurons
exact_observed_result: In 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, Apc perturbation induced Wnt feedback genes Axin2, Nkd1, and Notum and repressed neuronal markers such as Grin2c, Gls, Cck, and Chgb; Ctnnb1 knockdown produced a large response with the opposite beta-catenin/TCF direction for many targets, while Tcf7l2 overlapped only part of the Apc signature and changed Cck and Spock3 in the direction opposite to Apc.
biological_interpretation: The signatures place Apc, Ctnnb1, and Tcf7l2 at the Wnt/beta-catenin/TCF node in a thalamic neuronal context, but the neuronal outputs include synaptic and subtype markers rather than only canonical Axin2/Nkd1 feedback.

source_findings.summary: Apc and Tcf7l2 perturbations converged on a thalamic gene set but usually with opposite signs, indicating that APC/Wnt activation intersects rather than simply phenocopies Tcf7l2 loss.
source_findings.why_it_matters: TCF7L2 is a thalamic differentiation regulator; the Apc signature changed Cck, Spock3, Nexn and other genes that were also Tcf7l2-responsive, but the mostly opposite directions argue that Apc perturbation is an upstream signaling distortion superimposed on a Tcf7l2-dependent identity program.
source_findings.main_caveats: Only 29 genes were corrected hits in both Apc and Tcf7l2 contrasts; the mechanistic relationship could be indirect and stage-dependent.

source_findings.direction: strongest response in 151; smaller down-module in 145; target-only in 066 and 155
source_findings.summary: Ctnnb1 loss produced a broad corrected transcriptome almost exclusively in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, with a much smaller concordant response in 145 MH-LH TH Glut.
source_findings.why_it_matters: The result separates target RNA reduction from downstream pathway penetrance and makes cell type a first-order modifier of CTNNB1 biology in this brain dataset.
source_findings.cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|145 MH-LH TH Glut|066 CNU-HYa HY GABA|155 MB Glut
source_findings.main_caveats: Nineteen measured cell types lacked FDR-significant target RNA; low or unverified target engagement can mimic resistance.

source_findings.direction: Wnt feedback up; selected glutamatergic and peptide/neurosecretory genes down
source_findings.summary: Apc perturbation in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut activated a canonical Wnt negative-feedback module while repressing selected glutamatergic and peptide/neurosecretory markers.
source_findings.why_it_matters: Axin2, Nkd1 and Notum induction makes the strongest Perturb-seq response interpretable as beta-catenin pathway activation rather than an unstructured stress signature; the concurrent fall in Grin2c, Grin2d, Gls, Cck and Chgb shows that the Wnt response is coupled to thalamic neuronal-state genes.
source_findings.main_caveats: The assay is RNA-only; nuclear beta-catenin, APC protein abundance, and Wnt transcriptional reporter activity were not measured directly.

source_findings.direction: Notum up after Zfp612; Axin2 and Nkd1 unchanged after Zfp612; Apc upregulates Notum/Axin2/Nkd1 and Ctnnb1 downregulates Notum
source_findings.summary: Zfp612 perturbation produced a strong Notum induction in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, but this was uncoupled from a broader Apc/β-catenin feedback program.
source_findings.why_it_matters: NOTUM is a secreted Wnt antagonist, and Apc and Ctnnb1 perturbations validate Notum as Wnt-responsive in the same cell class; selective Notum induction therefore points to a focused Wnt-modulatory output rather than global canonical Wnt activation.
source_findings.main_caveats: The Notum evidence is single-gene and transcriptomic; Zfp612 binding at Notum was not measured; mature Zfp612 RNA knockdown was not significant.

source_findings.summary: Tcf7l2 perturbation produced an almost all-or-none response concentrated in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut cells.
source_findings.why_it_matters: The dataset resolves the Tcf7l2 effect to a narrow thalamic glutamatergic context rather than a pan-neuronal Wnt response.
source_findings.cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|009 L2-3 IT PIR AON ENT Glut
source_findings.main_caveats: The 009 cortical response was a single-gene Hp1bp3 hit and does not constitute a module; direct Tcf7l2 transcript depletion was not FDR-significant.

source_findings.summary: In 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, a Ctnnb1/Tcf7l2 down-regulated thalamic module overlapped Med13 but was uncoupled from Cdk8.
source_findings.why_it_matters: Prior cancer literature makes CDK8 a beta-catenin cofactor, but the neuronal Ctnnb1/Tcf7l2 module in this dataset does not require a Cdk8-like signature, arguing for context-specific beta-catenin cofactor usage.
source_findings.main_caveats: Mouse thalamic neurons and colon cancer cells are an indirect context match, and Cdk8 target engagement was weak.

evidence_ledger_rows.statistics: Gls logFC -0.498, FDR 1.17e-12; Grin2c logFC -0.588, FDR 1.92e-08; Grin2d logFC -0.819, FDR 9.53e-07; Cck logFC -0.597, FDR 4.64e-08; Chgb logFC -0.460, FDR 1.45e-06.
evidence_ledger_rows.description: Alongside Wnt feedback induction, Apc perturbation repressed neurotransmission and peptide-hormone-associated genes, including the Grin2c marker embedded in the cell-type label.

evidence_ledger_rows.statistics: Tcf7l2 perturbation: 111 perturbed cells and 106 FDR<0.05 genes; 29 genes overlapped the 303 Apc-significant genes and 27 of those 29 changed in the opposite direction; Pearson r across the Apc-significant genes was -0.214; Tcf7l2 increased Cck logFC 0.706, FDR 3.47e-12, whereas Apc decreased Cck logFC -0.597, FDR 4.64e-08; Tcf7l2 decreased Spock3 logFC -0.690, FDR 1.04e-11, whereas Apc increased Spock3 logFC 0.490, FDR 2.13e-11.
evidence_ledger_rows.description: The Tcf7l2 response in the same thalamic class overlapped Apc-responsive genes but did not simply reproduce the full Apc signature.

evidence_ledger_rows.statistics: Ctnnb1 was tested in 23 cell types; Ctnnb1 logFC was negative in 23/23, nominal p<0.05 in 14/23, and FDR<0.05 in 4/23. n_pert_matched ranged from 27 to 200 and n_ctrl_matched from 2019 to 23679.
evidence_ledger_rows.description: Direct target-transcript row summary for the Ctnnb1 perturbation across all measured cell types.

evidence_ledger_rows.statistics: 171 perturbed cells versus 23679 controls; 383 genes at FDR<0.05, including 283 down and 100 up. Ctnnb1 logFC -0.593 FDR 1.83e-10; Plekhg1 logFC -1.157 FDR 3.55e-25; Gabra4 logFC -0.758 FDR 7.85e-22; Ramp3 logFC -1.367 FDR 3.00e-21; Chgb logFC 0.696 FDR 1.76e-13.
evidence_ledger_rows.description: The strongest downstream Ctnnb1 response occurred in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut.

evidence_ledger_rows.statistics: 54 perturbed cells versus 6961 controls; 8 genes at FDR<0.05 and all had negative logFC. Ctnnb1 logFC -1.220 FDR 2.12e-6; Pdp1 logFC -0.958 FDR 0.00134; Gabra4 logFC -0.809 FDR 0.00838; L1cam logFC -0.532 FDR 0.00863; Nin logFC -0.891 FDR 0.0225. Scores over the 383 FDR genes from 151 correlated with 151 at r=0.710.
evidence_ledger_rows.description: A smaller habenular/thalamic glutamatergic response recapitulated a subset of the 151 down-signature.

evidence_ledger_rows.statistics: 101 perturbed cells versus 10110 controls; Ctnnb1 logFC -0.744 FDR 0.00128; 0 non-target genes at FDR<0.05. The strongest non-target row was Tbc1d9, logFC 0.539, nominal p=3.40e-4, FDR=1.0.
evidence_ledger_rows.description: A GABAergic class with significant target RNA reduction but no FDR-resolved downstream transcriptome.

evidence_ledger_rows.statistics: 200 perturbed cells versus 20353 controls; Ctnnb1 logFC -0.617 FDR 0.00133; 0 non-target genes at FDR<0.05. The strongest non-target row was Tef, logFC -0.382, nominal p=1.90e-5, FDR=0.166.
evidence_ledger_rows.description: A midbrain glutamatergic class with significant target RNA reduction but no FDR-significant downstream gene.

evidence_ledger_rows.statistics: 187 perturbed cells versus 23679 controls; 17259 genes tested; 303 genes at FDR<0.05, with 150 positive and 153 negative logFC; minimum FDR=9.18e-17.
evidence_ledger_rows.description: The thalamic Prkcd/Grin2c glutamatergic class carried the broadest corrected Apc response.

evidence_ledger_rows.statistics: Axin2 logFC 1.248, FDR 2.43e-16; Nkd1 logFC 2.455, FDR 2.14e-13; Notum logFC 1.562, FDR 4.39e-09.
evidence_ledger_rows.description: Apc perturbation induced canonical Wnt negative-feedback targets in the strongest responding cell type.

evidence_ledger_rows.statistics: Gls logFC -0.498, FDR 1.17e-12; Grin2c logFC -0.588, FDR 1.92e-08; Grin2d logFC -0.819, FDR 9.53e-07; Cck logFC -0.597, FDR 4.64e-08; Chgb logFC -0.460, FDR 1.45e-06.
evidence_ledger_rows.description: Alongside Wnt feedback induction, Apc perturbation repressed neurotransmission and peptide-hormone-associated genes, including the Grin2c marker embedded in the cell-type label.

evidence_ledger_rows.statistics: 252 Zfp612-perturbed cells versus 23679 controls; Notum score 6.821, logFC 1.014, p=9.02e-12, FDR=1.56e-7; Notum ranked 2/2046 by positive score and 3/2046 by absolute score among all perturbations in this cell type.
evidence_ledger_rows.description: Zfp612-targeting cells in the thalamic Prkcd/Grin2c glutamatergic class selectively upregulated Notum.

evidence_ledger_rows.statistics: Apc perturbation, 187 cells: Notum logFC 1.562 FDR 4.39e-9, Axin2 logFC 1.248 FDR 2.43e-16, Nkd1 logFC 2.455 FDR 2.14e-13. Ctnnb1 perturbation, 171 cells: Notum logFC -1.187, p=1.80e-5, FDR=0.00162.
evidence_ledger_rows.description: Canonical Wnt-pathway perturbations in the same cell class controlled the expected Wnt feedback genes and moved Notum in opposite directions.

evidence_ledger_rows.statistics: Under Zfp612 perturbation, Notum FDR=1.56e-7, whereas Axin2 logFC -0.093 p=0.399 FDR=1.000, Nkd1 logFC -0.104 p=0.721 FDR=1.000, and Ctnnb1 logFC -0.103 p=0.0161 FDR=1.000.
evidence_ledger_rows.description: The significant Notum induction was not accompanied by significant Axin2 or Nkd1 induction.

evidence_ledger_rows.statistics: Tcf7l2 was tested in 22 cell types; 107 total genes reached per-cell-type FDR<0.05, with 106/107 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut and the remaining singleton Hp1bp3 in 009 L2-3 IT PIR AON ENT Glut; 20/22 cell types had zero FDR<0.05 genes.
evidence_ledger_rows.description: Cell-type distribution of significant Wilcoxon differential-expression hits for the Tcf7l2 perturbation.

evidence_ledger_rows.statistics: 111 perturbed cells versus 23679 controls; 106 genes at FDR<0.05 and 140 at FDR<0.1; among FDR<0.05 genes 67 decreased and 39 increased. Ramp3 logFC -1.285 FDR 3.11e-17; Cck logFC 0.706 FDR 3.47e-12; Spock3 logFC -0.690 FDR 1.04e-11; Kcnc2 logFC -0.429 FDR 2.13e-10; Pcsk2 logFC -0.701 FDR 5.21e-10.
evidence_ledger_rows.description: The dominant Tcf7l2 perturbation response is a bidirectional thalamic glutamatergic transcriptional signature.

evidence_ledger_rows.statistics: The Tcf7l2 transcript row was not FDR-significant in any of 22 cell types; the lowest self FDR was in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut: logFC -0.210, Wilcoxon score -2.267, nominal p 0.0234, FDR 0.637.
evidence_ledger_rows.description: Direct measurement of the targeted transcript shows weak transcript-level engagement in the DE table.

evidence_ledger_rows.statistics: 154 Med13 cells versus 23,679 controls; 11 genes at FDR<0.05, including Prkcd logFC -0.427 FDR=2.46e-04, Grin2b -0.249 FDR=0.00110, Plekhg1 -0.317 FDR=0.00195, Pcp4 -0.324 FDR=0.00276, Lrrtm1 -0.382 FDR=0.00276, Atp2a2 -0.236 FDR=0.00276, Grm1 -0.229 FDR=0.00702, Ramp3 -0.304 FDR=0.00814, and Scnm1 +0.634 FDR=0.0434.
evidence_ledger_rows.description: Med13 produced a corrected thalamic neuronal module that was absent from Cdk8.

evidence_ledger_rows.statistics: Ctnnb1 perturbation, n=171, had 383 FDR<0.05 genes in 151 TH; top shared module genes included Plekhg1 logFC -1.157 FDR=3.55e-25, Ramp3 -1.367 FDR=3.00e-21, Pcp4 -0.651 FDR=9.48e-11, Grin2b -0.379 FDR=3.14e-09, and Prkcd -0.678 FDR=1.97e-09. Tcf7l2 perturbation, n=111, had 106 FDR<0.05 genes, including Ramp3 FDR=3.11e-17, Plekhg1 FDR=3.20e-09, Pcp4 FDR=1.37e-06, Grin2b FDR=5.15e-04, and Prkcd FDR=7.74e-04.
evidence_ledger_rows.description: Ctnnb1 and Tcf7l2 produced strong, overlapping signatures in the same thalamic class where Cdk8 was nearly null.

evidence_ledger_rows.statistics: All-gene Pearson score correlations in 151 TH: Med13-Ctnnb1 r=0.168, Med13-Tcf7l2 r=0.062, Cdk8-Ctnnb1 r=-0.036, Cdk8-Tcf7l2 r=-0.053, Cdk8-Med13 r=-0.047. Top-50 nominal gene overlap: Med13 with Ctnnb1=13, Med13 with Tcf7l2=7, Cdk8 with Med13=0, Cdk8 with Ctnnb1=1, Cdk8 with Tcf7l2=1.
evidence_ledger_rows.description: The thalamic Cdk8 vector failed to align with Med13, Ctnnb1, or Tcf7l2 despite shared candidate genes in the comparator signatures.

caveats: Tcf7l2 was a partial antagonist of the Apc state rather than a perfect inverse.
The Cdk8 and Zfp612 branches were comparator evidence, not equal drivers of the Wnt-node claim.
